purpose: Define deterministic packet-window construction and feature calculations used identically for Dataset-B offline extraction and Exp011 live inference.

traffic_scope.scope_statement: Only bidirectional victim HTTP/TCP port 80 packets admitted by the acquisition capture filter are eligible for Dataset-B windows.

windowing.window_selection_rule: A single packet count will be selected using validation-set evidence before final model training and then frozen for deployment.

packet_interpretation.packet_length: captured network-layer IPv4 total length in bytes
packet_interpretation.header_length: IPv4 header length plus TCP header length for observed TCP packets.
packet_interpretation.protocol: TCP only under the frozen Dataset-B capture scope.
packet_interpretation.tcp_flags: TCP FIN SYN RST PSH ACK bits from observed TCP header
packet_interpretation.iat: difference in capture timestamps between consecutive packets within the same window after timestamp ordering

features.name: packet_count
features.definition: Number of packets in the window.

features.name: duration_seconds
features.definition: Last packet capture timestamp minus first packet capture timestamp.

features.name: header_length_mean
features.definition: Arithmetic mean of defined per-packet protocol header lengths.

features.name: ttl_mean
features.definition: Arithmetic mean of IPv4 TTL values.

features.name: fin_fraction
features.definition: Packets with TCP FIN set divided by packet_count.

features.name: syn_fraction
features.definition: Packets with TCP SYN set divided by packet_count.

features.name: rst_fraction
features.definition: Packets with TCP RST set divided by packet_count.

features.name: psh_fraction
features.definition: Packets with TCP PSH set divided by packet_count.

features.name: ack_fraction
features.definition: Packets with TCP ACK set divided by packet_count.

features.name: packet_length_sum
features.definition: Sum of IPv4 total lengths.

features.name: packet_length_min
features.definition: Minimum IPv4 total length.

features.name: packet_length_max
features.definition: Maximum IPv4 total length.

features.name: packet_length_mean
features.definition: Arithmetic mean of IPv4 total lengths.

features.name: packet_length_std
features.definition: Population standard deviation of IPv4 total lengths.

features.name: packet_length_variance
features.definition: Population variance of IPv4 total lengths.

features.name: iat_mean
features.definition: Arithmetic mean of consecutive-packet inter-arrival times inside the window.

features.name: iat_min
features.definition: Minimum consecutive-packet inter-arrival time.

features.name: iat_max
features.definition: Maximum consecutive-packet inter-arrival time.

features.name: iat_std
features.definition: Population standard deviation of consecutive-packet inter-arrival times.

features.name: packet_rate
features.definition: packet_count divided by duration_seconds when duration_seconds is positive.
